fusions.name: Grapple Tongue
fusions.desc: Fires a sprung tongue at an enemy up to 7 tiles away, which deals 12 damage and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Bellows Croak
fusions.desc: Pumps a croak through a brass bellows across a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Coiled Haunches
fusions.desc: Spring-loaded legs fling you 5 tiles forward, and you move 15% faster for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Primed Pads
fusions.desc: While your stamina sits full, your springs stay primed: your crit chance rises by 30% for 3 seconds. Once every 9 seconds.
